  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Two-level Gaussian DSEM}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

The experimental R reference sampler estimates a Gaussian AR(1) with
person-specific intercepts and autoregressive effects. Population parameters
and the random-effect covariance are estimated jointly. This is the first
two-level slice; latent centering, covariates, random residual variances, and
Mplus parity are still gated.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
model <- dsem_model("y ~ lag(y, 1)", id = "person", time = "occasion")

fit <- dsem(model, data = long_data, engine = "R")
coef(fit)
fit$random_effects
```

Use this estimator for development and recovery studies only. It has not yet
passed the Mplus 9.30--9.32 parity gates.
